title: SvgFilter
responsibility: Renders the native filter element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFilter.attributes
inputs.description: Native filter attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgFilter.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native filter element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgFilter
outputs.description: The actual native filter element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
